meta.name: add-webex
meta.description: Add Webex channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 在应用中集成Webex聊天频道
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在应用里接入Webex聊天功能。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Webex chat into your app.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Webex chat to your app.

howto.what: 它会从 channels 分支复制 Webex 适配器及其注册测试到 src/channels/,把注册用的 import 追加到渠道 barrel,安装固定版本的适配器包,然后执行构建并跑那条注册测试。凭证和 webhook 需要人工按说明在 Webex 后台完成。
howto.when: 当你要求给 NanoClaw 添加 Webex 渠道集成时接管;注册测试变红、或适配器导入与依赖缺失时,也会按 Apply 步骤重新执行。

say.text: 给项目加上 Webex 渠道集成
say.note: 会复制适配器、注册并跑测试

say.text: 跑一下 webex-registration 测试,看适配器装好没
say.note: 红=barrel 导入或依赖有问题

howto.what_en: It copies the Webex adapter and its registration test from the `channels` branch into src/channels/, appends the import to the channel barrel, installs the pinned adapter package, then builds and runs the registration test. Credentials and the webhook are set up by hand.
howto.when_en: When you ask to add Webex channel integration to NanoClaw, or when the registration test goes red and the Apply steps need re-running.

say_en.text: Add Webex channel integration to my project
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, registers it, runs the test

say_en.text: Run the webex-registration test to check the adapter
say_en.note: Red means the barrel import or install broke

say_en.text: Write my Webex Bot Token and webhook secret to .env
say_en.note: Values you already set are not overwritten
